title: Mother of Dragons
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ castles in the Lannister's Kingdom and some walls connect two castles, no two castles are connected by more than one wall, no wall connects a castle to itself.

Sir Jaime Lannister has discovered that Daenerys Targaryen is going to attack his kingdom soon. Therefore he wants to defend his kingdom. He has $*k*$ liters of a strange liquid. He wants to distribute that liquid among the castles, so each castle may contain some liquid (possibly zero or non-integer number of liters). After that the stability of a wall is defined as follows: if the wall connects two castles $*a*$ and $*b*$, and they contain $*x*$ and $*y*$ liters of that liquid, respectively, then the strength of that wall is $*x*·*y*$.

Your task is to print the maximum possible sum of stabilities of the walls that Sir Jaime Lannister can achieve.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 40$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$).

Then $*n*$ lines follows. The $*i*$-th of these lines contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*, 1}, *a*_{*i*, 2}, ..., *a*_{*i*, *n*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ec278d042b998ad173414d9a64a4289322f5b6d0.png)). If castles $*i*$ and $*j*$ are connected by a wall, then $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = 1$. Otherwise it is equal to $0$.

It is guaranteed that $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*j*, *i*}$ and $*a*_{*i*, *i*} = 0$ for all $1 ≤ *i*, *j* ≤ *n*$.

## Output

Print the maximum possible sum of stabilities of the walls that Sir Jaime Lannister can achieve.

Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf9a7a80dafa0f6b2f4d2f115f2c4acade6b8b94.png).

## Note

In the first sample, we can assign $0.5, 0.5, 0$ liters of liquid to castles $1, 2, 3$, respectively, to get the maximum sum ($0.25$).

In the second sample, we can assign $1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0$ liters of liquid to castles $1, 2, 3, 4$, respectively, to get the maximum sum ($4.0$)
statementZhMd:
兰尼斯特王国中有 $*n*$ 座城堡，其中一些城堡之间由城墙相连。任意两座城堡之间至多有一面城墙相连，且没有城墙连接同一座城堡。

詹姆·兰尼斯特爵士发现丹妮莉丝·坦格利安即将进攻他的王国。因此，他想要保卫自己的王国。他有 $*k*$ 升奇怪的液体。他希望将这些液体分配到各座城堡中，使得每座城堡中可以有一定量的液体（可以为零，也可以不是整数）。之后，一面城墙的稳定性定义如下：如果一面城墙连接城堡 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$，且它们中分别装有 $*x*$ 升和 $*y*$ 升该液体，那么这面城墙的强度为 $*x*·*y*$。

你的任务是输出詹姆·兰尼斯特爵士能够达到的城墙稳定性总和的最大值。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 40$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$）。

接下来有 $*n*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*, 1}, *a*_{*i*, 2}, ..., *a*_{*i*, *n*}$（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ec278d042b998ad173414d9a64a4289322f5b6d0.png)）。如果城堡 $*i*$ 和 $*j*$ 之间由城墙相连，则 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = 1$；否则其值为 $0$。

保证对于所有 $1 ≤ *i*, *j* ≤ *n*$，都有 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*j*, *i*}$ 且 $*a*_{*i*, *i*} = 0$。

## 输出格式

输出詹姆·兰尼斯特爵士能够达到的城墙稳定性总和的最大值。

如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说：假设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测程序的答案为 $*b*$。如果 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf9a7a80dafa0f6b2f4d2f115f2c4acade6b8b94.png)，则评测程序会认为你的答案是正确的。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，我们可以分别向城堡 $1$、$2$、$3$ 分配 $0.5$、$0.5$、$0$ 升液体，从而得到最大的总和（$0.25$）。

在第二个样例中，我们可以分别向城堡 $1$、$2$、$3$、$4$ 分配 $1.0$、$1.0$、$1.0$、$1.0$ 升液体，从而得到最大的总和（$4.0$）。
